external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The scheme will be developed by Vienna-based JP Immobilien and its hospitality division JP Hospitality, with construction expected to commence later this summer. Staycity Group has secured a 20-year lease on the asset, which will comprise a mix of new-build and the conversion of existing retail and office accommodation.
Marc P. Werner and Sabrina Greubel of Hogan Lovells International LLP in Frankfurt acted as lawyers for Staycity Group during negotiations.
Linda Pettit, Tilburstow Media Partners, Tel: +44 79 7378 9853

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Dublin-based Staycity Group was established in 2004 by CEO and co-founder Tom Walsh. The company now operates 6,400 aparthotel rooms in 39 aparthotels across 20 vibrant cities, appealing to both business and leisure travellers from across the globe.

network.coverage_note: The institution is a commercial aparthotel operator, not an educational institution, so it does not have Erasmus+ partners or academic campuses. The provided partner list reflects business and development partners mentioned in press releases.
